entities.name: TMEM242
observations: The 140-aa query sequence exactly matches reviewed mouse TMEM242 (UniProt Q8VCR3); human TMEM242 is 85.8% identical over the full length.
TMEM242 is a small multi-pass protein of the mitochondrial inner membrane.
TMEM242 functions as a scaffold for mitochondrial ATP synthase c-ring assembly, promoting membrane insertion and oligomerization of ATP5MC3/subunit c.
TMEM242 also influences incorporation of MT-ATP6, MT-ATP8, ATP5MJ, and ATP5MK into ATP synthase.
The sequence contains Pfam DUF1358 (PF07096.17), residues 12–123.
Sequence-derived properties: length 140 aa, molecular weight approximately 14.9 kDa, predicted pI 6.73.

entities.name: Mitochondrial ATP synthase assembly
observations: TMEM242 participates in assembly of the mitochondrial proton-transporting ATP synthase complex, especially c-ring formation and incorporation of associated membrane subunits.

entities.name: Mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation
observations: TMEM242 is localized to the mitochondrial inner membrane and supports assembly of complex V, linking it to oxidative phosphorylation machinery.
